facts.business: Priya Limited is engaged in the business of Trading in Electronics and Chemicals.

auditor.name: JM & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Adverse opinion due to NPA status, negative net worth, nil revenue from operations, auction of properties by banks, wilful defaulter declaration, and unprovided tax on notional gains from asset auctions.

key_risks: Company's accounts declared as NPA with symbolic attachment of properties under SARFAESI Act
Accumulated losses exceed net worth resulting in negative net worth
Revenue from operations is nil due to blockage of bank accounts
Properties auctioned by banks with proceeds not fully accounted
Company, promoters, and directors declared as wilful defaulters by three lender banks
Summons received from Debts Recovery Tribunal (DRT) Mumbai
Provision of Rs. 3,953.81 lakhs for doubtful debtors without RBI/FEMA approval for write-off
CFO vacancy since December 2022 not filled within prescribed time limit
Auditor unable to comment on company's capability to meet liabilities within one year
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with Sec 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 and details have been disclosed in the Financial Statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
